descriptions.text: Make a colorful impression with our signature ink. Classic Stampin' Ink Refills come in exclusive Stampin' Up! colors, grouped in collections to take the guesswork out of product coordination. * Fast drying, dye-based ink * Crumb Cake * Acid free * Use to re-ink Classic Stampin’ Pads or use for spritzing or watercoloring * Coordinates with Stampin’ Up! cardstock, markers, and embellishments * 0.5 fl. oz. (14.8 ml)

descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. And it’s dyed with pure color all the way through so there’s no white core. * 24 sheets * 8-1/2" x 11" * Sahara Sand * Acid free * Lignin free
